OSPS-AC-01.01.justification: The btclib-org organization requires two-factor authentication of every member and accepts only secure methods, not SMS. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/issues/1362#issuecomment-5903994882

OSPS-AC-02.01.justification: A new member gets read access, the organization's base permission. Every higher grant is assigned by hand. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/REPOSITORY.md

OSPS-AC-03.01.justification: The main-self-merge ruleset requires a pull request for every change to main. Its one bypass actor holds it in pull_request mode, which never allows a direct push. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#branch-protection-and-rulesets

OSPS-AC-03.02.justification: The main-integrity ruleset forbids deleting main and has no bypass actor. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#branch-protection-and-rulesets

OSPS-AC-04.01.justification: The default GITHUB_TOKEN is read-only at the organization and the repository, and cannot approve pull requests. Every workflow also sets permissions: contents: read at the top. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#tokens-publishing-scanning

OSPS-AC-04.02.justification: Every workflow sets permissions: contents: read at the top, and a job adds a write scope only where it uses it. zizmor's excessive-permissions audit runs in the required lint check. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#what-every-workflow-does

OSPS-BR-01.01.justification: No workflow uses pull_request_target or workflow_run. Event fields and inputs reach run: steps only through env:, and zizmor's template-injection audit in the required lint check refuses the unsafe form. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml

OSPS-BR-01.03.justification: Pull-request runs use the pull_request and pull_request_review_comment triggers, which give a fork no secrets and a read-only token. The review job, which holds a secret, runs only when the head repository is this one. The mention job holds a secret on any pull request's issue comment, and there checks out the default branch. It answers only users with write access, and its tools exclude Bash, edits, writes and file reads. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/.github/workflows/reusable-claude-review.yml

OSPS-BR-01.04.justification: The only workflow_dispatch input is mutation.yml's profile, a choice from a fixed list. A release tag's name is checked against the package version before anything is built. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/.github/workflows/mutation.yml

OSPS-BR-02.01.justification: Each release has a unique calendar version (YYYY.M.D), set by a signed v* tag. release.yml refuses a tag that disagrees with the package version or is not on main, and PyPI never accepts a version twice. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/releases

OSPS-BR-02.02.justification: Every release asset carries the version in its file name: the sdist, the wheel, the CycloneDX SBOM and the attestation bundle. The attestation binds each asset to its digest. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/releases/latest

OSPS-BR-03.01.justification: Every official channel the project lists is served over HTTPS only: the GitHub repository, its issue tracker and advisories, and the documentation at https://btclib-mnemonics.readthedocs.io/.

OSPS-BR-03.02.justification: Releases are distributed through PyPI and GitHub Releases, both HTTPS only. PyPI files carry PEP 740 attestations and the GitHub release a Sigstore bundle. https://pypi.org/project/btclib-mnemonics/

OSPS-BR-04.01.justification: The GitHub release body is RELEASE_NOTES.md's entry: what a user must act on, breaking and security changes included. CHANGELOG.md lists every change. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/RELEASE_NOTES.md

OSPS-BR-05.01.justification: Pipelines take Python dependencies from PyPI. The required test check runs the suite with uv from the committed uv.lock with --locked. pre-commit installs its hooks with pip at the revisions .pre-commit-config.yaml pins. Third-party actions are pinned by commit SHA. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#uvlock

OSPS-BR-06.01.justification: Every PyPI file carries a PEP 740 attestation from Trusted Publishing. The GitHub release carries a Sigstore build-provenance bundle over each asset's SHA-256. The tag is signed. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/releases/latest

OSPS-BR-07.01.justification: Secret scanning and push protection are on, so a push carrying a recognised credential is refused. The detect-private-key and detect-secrets hooks run in the required lint check. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/.secrets.baseline

OSPS-BR-07.02.justification: A secret is an environment secret only the owners reach, and any other store's entry is recorded in the spending repository's REPOSITORY.md. A secret is rotated when an owner changes or an exposure is suspected, and the list is reviewed yearly. btclib-org/.github's tests/secrets_test.py refuses an unrecorded entry. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/7bc0f27d387604b70df8e4cb03afe873f6a821bb/README.md#L2913-L2940

OSPS-DO-01.01.justification: The user documentation is README.md's first use, which tests/readme_test.py runs, and the API reference at https://btclib-mnemonics.readthedocs.io/.

OSPS-DO-02.01.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md says where a defect is filed, and the bug-report form asks for what a report needs. SECURITY.md sends a vulnerability to a private channel instead. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml

OSPS-DO-03.01.justification: SECURITY.md gives the gh attestation verify command for the release assets, and RELEASING.md the check that rebuilds the sdist from its tag. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/SECURITY.md

OSPS-DO-03.02.justification: The verify command pins the signer: --repo names this repository, --signer-workflow the organization's reusable-build.yml (reusable-attest.yml for earlier releases) and --source-ref the release tag. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/SECURITY.md

OSPS-DO-04.01.justification: SECURITY.md's *Supported versions*: only the latest release is supported, a fix ships as a new release, and nothing is backported. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/SECURITY.md

OSPS-DO-05.01.justification: SECURITY.md: only the latest release is supported, so a release stops receiving security updates when the next one is published. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/SECURITY.md

OSPS-DO-06.01.justification: The package has no runtime dependency: pyproject.toml declares dependencies = []. uv obtains the development dependencies from PyPI and pins them in uv.lock, and Dependabot tracks them weekly with a seven-day cooldown. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#dependabot-and-pre-commitci

OSPS-DO-07.01.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md gives the build: uv is the only prerequisite, uv sync builds the environment from uv.lock, and uv build produces the sdist and wheel. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

OSPS-GV-01.01.justification: GOVERNANCE.md's Roles names who holds access to sensitive resources: the maintainer, the only bypass actor, and the three owners, each an administrator of every repository and a reviewer of the publishing environments. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles

OSPS-GV-01.02.justification: GOVERNANCE.md's *Roles* describes the maintainer, owners, repository collaborators, contributors, reviewers, the review bot, Dependabot and pre-commit.ci, and what each owes. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles

OSPS-GV-02.01.justification: Proposed changes and usage obstacles are discussed publicly in the repository's GitHub issues (with a question form) and pull requests; cross-repository questions go to btclib-org/.github's tracker. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/issues

OSPS-GV-03.01.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md explains the contribution process: one subject per pull request, the local gates, the review and the landing. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

OSPS-GV-03.02.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md states what a contribution must meet: one subject, a Signed-off-by trailer on every commit, the gates CI runs, 100% line and branch coverage, and a review against REVIEWING.md. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

OSPS-GV-04.01.justification: https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/7bc0f27d387604b70df8e4cb03afe873f6a821bb/GOVERNANCE.md#L44-L46 : a grant of write or admin, to any repository of the organization, is an issue in btclib-org/.github that states the reason, and an owner other than the one asking approves it there.

OSPS-LE-01.01.justification: main requires the lint / Sign-off check, so a pull request cannot merge unless every commit carries its author's Signed-off-by: trailer. Web commits are signed off automatically. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/.github/scripts/check_sign_off.py

OSPS-LE-02.01.justification: The source code is under the MIT license, which the OSI approves. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/LICENSE

OSPS-LE-02.02.justification: The released wheels and sdist declare License-Expression: MIT, the same OSI-approved license as the source. https://pypi.org/project/btclib-mnemonics/

OSPS-LE-03.01.justification: The license text is the repository's root LICENSE file. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/LICENSE

OSPS-LE-03.02.justification: The LICENSE file ships inside every release asset: the sdist root and the wheel's .dist-info/licenses/. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/LICENSE

OSPS-QA-01.01.justification: The repository is public on GitHub at a static URL. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics

OSPS-QA-01.02.justification: Git history on GitHub records every change with its author, committer, date and signature; linear history and no force-pushes on main keep that record from being rewritten. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/commits/main

OSPS-QA-02.01.justification: pyproject.toml declares the direct dependencies, none at run time and the development tools in dependency groups, and the committed uv.lock pins them. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/pyproject.toml

OSPS-QA-02.02.justification: Every release attaches a CycloneDX 1.6 SBOM generated from the built wheel and covered by the release attestation. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/releases/latest

OSPS-QA-03.01.justification: main requires the listed status checks, up to date with main. enforce_admins is off, so an admin merge without them is a manual bypass, which the control allows. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#branch-protection-and-rulesets

OSPS-QA-04.01.justification: The organization standard's section 2 (*Which repositories, and how far*) lists every repository of btclib-org and its tier, and the organization profile lists the published packages. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#which-repositories-and-how-far

OSPS-QA-04.02.justification: The project has no additional subproject repository: each release is built from this one repository, and the package has no dependencies.

OSPS-QA-05.01.justification: No generated executable is committed. The only binary file is the Sphinx inventory python.inv, and the lint gate's check-added-large-files keeps build output out.

OSPS-QA-05.02.justification: No executable, library or compiled file is committed. The only binary file is docs/source/_inventories/python.inv, which is not code.

OSPS-QA-06.01.justification: test.yml's aggregate check ('test: every job passed') runs the test suite on every pull request and is a required status check on main. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/.github/workflows/test.yml

OSPS-QA-06.02.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md's *The environment and the gates* gives the command that runs the suite and which workflows run it on every pull request, on main and on a schedule, and which of them gate a merge. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

OSPS-QA-06.03.justification: The policy is 100% line and branch coverage (CONTRIBUTING.md, standard section 8). pyproject.toml sets fail_under = 100, so untested new code fails the required test check. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/pyproject.toml

OSPS-QA-07.01.justification: main's ruleset requires one approving review, but the maintainer's pull_request-mode bypass remains, and recent pull requests landed without a non-author approval. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#review

OSPS-SA-01.01.justification: CLAUDE.md's Architecture gives the components and their layering. ASSURANCE_CASE.md's Threat model and Trust boundaries name the actors and what each can do. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/CLAUDE.md#architecture

OSPS-SA-02.01.justification: The API reference at https://btclib-mnemonics.readthedocs.io/ is generated from the docstrings of every public module, and tests/docs_test.py fails when a shipped module is missing from it. CONTRIBUTING.md's The public surface states what is public.

OSPS-SA-03.01.justification: ASSURANCE_CASE.md is the security assessment: what is claimed, the threat model, the trust boundaries and how each common implementation weakness is countered; SECURITY.md's limitations section records the known residual risks. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/ASSURANCE_CASE.md

OSPS-SA-03.02.justification: ASSURANCE_CASE.md's *Threat model* names the assets, adversaries and what is not defended, and *Trust boundaries* maps the attack surface where untrusted input enters, each argument naming the file, test or workflow behind it. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/ASSURANCE_CASE.md

OSPS-VM-01.01.justification: SECURITY.md gives the private reporting channels and states the timeframes: a report is acknowledged within 7 days, and a fix or a published advisory follows within 90 days. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/SECURITY.md#L19

OSPS-VM-02.01.justification: SECURITY.md names the security contacts: a private GitHub security advisory, or email to security at btclib dot org, which reaches the three organization owners. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/SECURITY.md

OSPS-VM-03.01.justification: Private vulnerability reporting is enabled, and SECURITY.md points to it (the Security tab's 'Report a vulnerability') and gives an email address as the alternative. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/security/advisories/new

OSPS-VM-04.01.justification: Vulnerabilities are published as GitHub security advisories on this repository, each naming the release that fixes it. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/security/advisories

OSPS-VM-04.02.justification: Each release's CycloneDX SBOM lists in its vulnerabilities array every vulnerability judged not to affect it, with the reason, from the tree's .github/vex.toml. None is judged so today, so the tree has no such file. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/7bc0f27d387604b70df8e4cb03afe873f6a821bb/README.md#L3120-L3135

OSPS-VM-05.01.justification: Every pull request runs actions/dependency-review-action, which fails on an added or changed dependency with an advisory of moderate severity or above, or with a licence outside the allow-list. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/7bc0f27d387604b70df8e4cb03afe873f6a821bb/README.md#L2892-L2909

OSPS-VM-05.02.justification: release.yml runs uv audit over every dependency the wheel declares before any publish job. An advisory, or a service it cannot reach, stops the release. The only exemption is an id the release's own signed VEX states as not affecting it. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/7bc0f27d387604b70df8e4cb03afe873f6a821bb/README.md#L3149-L3160

OSPS-VM-05.03.justification: The Dependency review job runs on every pull request and is a required check on main (lint / Dependency review), so a pull request that violates the policy cannot merge. Policy: https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/7bc0f27d387604b70df8e4cb03afe873f6a821bb/README.md#L2892-L2909

OSPS-VM-06.01.justification: The standard's section 5 sets the threshold at zero: ruff runs select = ALL, bandit's S rules included, and each finding is fixed or suppressed in place with a reason. zizmor holds workflows to the same. CodeQL alerts have no stated threshold. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#5-ruff

OSPS-VM-06.02.justification: The required lint check runs .pre-commit-config.yaml on every pull request (ruff with the S rules, strict mypy, zizmor, detect-secrets) and blocks the merge on any finding not suppressed in place with a reason. CodeQL also runs on every pull request but is not a required check. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/.github/workflows/lint.yml

access_continuity.justification: The organization has three owners, fametrano, giacomocaironi and pmazzocchi, each an administrator of this repository and a reviewer of its publishing environments. If one becomes unavailable, the other two can still close issues, merge changes and release. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#continuity

accessibility_best_practices.justification: btclib-mnemonics is a library with no user interface: no CLI, no GUI and no web front end, so accessibility best practices have no surface to apply to. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/README.md

assurance_case.justification: ASSURANCE_CASE.md gives the threat model (what is defended, the adversaries, what is not defended), the trust boundaries, the secure design principles and the common implementation weaknesses with what counters each, naming the file, test or workflow behind every argument. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/ASSURANCE_CASE.md

automated_integration_testing.justification: test.yml runs the test suite, on every supported interpreter, on every push to main and every pull request, and its aggregate job `test: every job passed` is a required check. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/.github/workflows/test.yml

build_non_recursive.justification: This tree builds no native binaries, so there is no recursive-build question to answer. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/pyproject.toml

build_preserve_debug.justification: No native build or installation step exists to strip or preserve debugging information. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/pyproject.toml

build_repeatable.justification: Pure-Python source is used directly (uv_build, no compilation step), so there is nothing whose bit-for-bit regeneration to test. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/pyproject.toml

build_reproducible.justification: The sdist is built with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH from the commit and normalized by .github/scripts/normalize_sdist.py. sdist-rebuild.yml rebuilds the latest release's sdist from its tag every week and verifies it against the release's build-provenance attestation. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/actions/workflows/sdist-rebuild.yml

build_standard_variables.justification: This tree builds no native binaries -- it is pure Python on the uv_build backend -- so there is no compiler or linker invocation for CC/CFLAGS/LDFLAGS to reach. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/pyproject.toml

bus_factor.justification: Almost every commit is the maintainer's, and one other person wrote one merged pull request. Continuity rests on the three organization owners, each an administrator of this repository. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md

code_of_conduct.justification: btclib-org/.github's CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md is this repository's code of conduct, through GitHub's organization-wide default; the community-profile API reports it. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md

code_review_standards.justification: REVIEWING.md states what a review checks, how a finding is written and what clears a pull request; the part shared by every repository is followed by what this tree checks in particular. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/REVIEWING.md

coding_standards.justification: pyproject.toml selects every ruff rule (select = ["ALL"]) with a documented ignore list, and runs mypy in strict mode. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/pyproject.toml

coding_standards_enforced.justification: ruff-check, ruff-format and mypy run as pre-commit hooks, and lint.yml runs the same .pre-commit-config.yaml in CI as a required check, so the style is enforced automatically rather than by review alone. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/.pre-commit-config.yaml

contribution_requirements.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md states the public-surface, input-validation, lint-gate and 100%-coverage requirements a contribution must meet before it can land. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

contributors_unassociated.justification: One outside contributor so far, in https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/pull/28; there are not yet two significant unassociated contributors. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/graphs/contributors

copyright_per_file.justification: Every Python file opens with "Copyright (c) The btclib developers", and ruff's flake8-copyright rule (CPY001) keeps it there, e.g. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/src/btclib_mnemonics/__init__.py

crypto_algorithm_agility.justification: The algorithms are fixed by the specifications the package implements -- a BIP39, SLIP-0039 or Electrum sentence has to stretch to the seed every other implementation computes -- so there is no alternative algorithm a user could switch to without leaving the standard. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/README.md

crypto_call.justification: Every primitive is called from the standard library -- hashlib's sha256, sha512 and pbkdf2_hmac, hmac, secrets and os.urandom -- and none is reimplemented. What the package writes itself is only what the specifications define above those primitives: SLIP-0039's GF(256) interpolation and its Feistel structure, and the mnemonic encodings. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/tree/main/src/btclib_mnemonics

crypto_certificate_verification.justification: btclib-mnemonics performs no network communications -- nothing under src/ imports socket, ssl, http or urllib -- and so uses no TLS. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/tree/main/src/btclib_mnemonics

crypto_credential_agility.justification: btclib-mnemonics is a library with no configuration file or credential store: entropy, mnemonics, passphrases and shares are caller-supplied function parameters, never read from or written to a file this project owns. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/ASSURANCE_CASE.md

crypto_floss.justification: no closed source dependencies: the standard library alone

crypto_keylength.justification: Every default meets 112 bits: bip39.mnemonic_from_entropy draws 128 bits when given none, electrum's generator draws 132 bits rounded up to whole words, and slip39 refuses a master secret under 128 bits. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/tree/main/src/btclib_mnemonics

crypto_password_storage.justification: does not store passwords: a passphrase is stretched into a seed and handed back, never stored or used to authenticate anyone

crypto_pfs.justification: implements no network key-agreement protocol: the package performs no network communications at all

crypto_published.justification: Every mechanism is a published one: BIP39 (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512, SHA-256 checksum), SLIP-0039 (Shamir sharing over GF(256), an HMAC-SHA256 digest share, a four-round Feistel network whose round function is PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256) and Electrum's seed schemes (HMAC-SHA512 version prefix, PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512, and the pre-2.0 iterated SHA-256), each checked against the vectors its authors publish. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/README.md

crypto_random.justification: Every random draw comes from the operating system's CSPRNG: secrets for BIP39's and Electrum's default entropy and the simulated dice, and os.urandom for SLIP-0039's default entropy_source. Nothing under src/ uses the random module. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/ASSURANCE_CASE.md

crypto_tls12.justification: btclib-mnemonics performs no network communications and so uses no TLS. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/tree/main/src/btclib_mnemonics

crypto_used_network.justification: btclib-mnemonics does not use the network: nothing under src/ imports socket, ssl, http or urllib. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/tree/main/src/btclib_mnemonics

crypto_verification_private.justification: btclib-mnemonics performs no network communications and so uses no TLS. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/tree/main/src/btclib_mnemonics

crypto_weaknesses.justification: No SHA-1 or MD5 appears under src/: the hashes are SHA-256 and SHA-512, alone, in HMAC or in PBKDF2, with the iteration counts the specifications fix (BIP39's and Electrum's 2048, SLIP-0039's 10000 * 2^e, the pre-2.0 Electrum scheme's 100000). https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/tree/main/src/btclib_mnemonics

dco.justification: Every commit carries its author's Signed-off-by: trailer: main requires the lint / Sign-off check, which refuses a pull request with a commit lacking it. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/.github/scripts/check_sign_off.py

delivery_mitm.justification: Distribution channels use HTTPS exclusively: GitHub, and PyPI through Trusted Publishing. [osps_br_03_02]

dependency_monitoring.justification: Dependabot version updates cover uv, github-actions and docker, and Dependabot security updates are on. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml

discussion.justification: GitHub supports discussions on issues and pull requests.

documentation_achievements.justification: README.md links the OpenSSF Scorecard, Best Practices and Baseline badges on the lines the organization standard reserves for them. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/README.md

documentation_architecture.justification: CLAUDE.md's Architecture gives the layers bottom-up (exceptions and _utils, entropy and mnemonic, the schemes bip39, electrum and slip39, none importing another, and dispatch), and states that the package imports only the standard library and stops at the seed. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/CLAUDE.md#architecture

documentation_basics.justification: README.md says what the package holds and what it does not, how to install it, and gives a first use that tests/readme_test.py runs; CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md and ASSURANCE_CASE.md cover the rest. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/README.md

documentation_current.justification: The docs build is gated in CI as a required check (docs.yml, `-n -W`), tests/docs_test.py fails when a shipped module has no API page, and tests/readme_test.py runs every Python block of README.md, so neither the reference generated from the docstrings nor the README's example can drift from the code. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/.github/workflows/docs.yml

documentation_interface.justification: Every public module and function carries a docstring, gated by ruff's pydocstyle rules and pydoclint, and docs/source's automodule pages render them into the API reference published at https://btclib-mnemonics.readthedocs.io/; tests/docs_test.py fails when a shipped module is missing from them.

documentation_quick_start.justification: README.md's *A seed from a mnemonic, and a secret split into shares* is a first use -- a BIP39 sentence from entropy, its seed, its scheme recognized, and a SLIP-0039 2-of-3 split recombined -- and tests/readme_test.py runs it, so it is the one the suite checks. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/README.md

documentation_roadmap.justification: ROADMAP.md, organization-wide in btclib-org/.github, covers the period until 2027-09-30, is reviewed every September, and states what is intended and what is deliberately not; this tree's README.md links it. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/ROADMAP.md

documentation_security.justification: SECURITY.md's Limitations, not vulnerabilities states the known limits: secret material is not zeroized, nothing is constant-time, randomness comes from the operating system, and the dice collector is interactive. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/SECURITY.md

dynamic_analysis.justification: mutation testing and fuzzing (ClusterFuzzLite over every decoder, and Hypothesis in tests/fuzz_test.py): https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/actions/workflows/mutation.yml, https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/actions/workflows/fuzz.yml

dynamic_analysis_unsafe.justification: This tree ships pure Python, a memory-safe language; it produces no software written in a memory-unsafe language for a dynamic memory-safety tool to run against. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/pyproject.toml

enhancement_responses.justification: Contributions are answered and merged: https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/pull/28, an outside contributor's fix, was merged the day it was opened.

external_dependencies.justification: pyproject.toml declares `dependencies = []` -- the package imports the standard library alone, which tests/imports_test.py asserts of every module -- and the test and tooling dependencies in its dependency-groups, resolved and pinned in the committed uv.lock. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/pyproject.toml

floss_license.justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).

floss_license_osi.justification: The MIT license is approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).

governance.justification: GOVERNANCE.md, organization-wide in btclib-org/.github, documents the decision model and every role a contributor, reviewer or owner holds; this tree's README.md links it. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md

hardened_site.justification: https://btclib.org/btclib-mnemonics/ is served over HTTPS with Content-Security-Policy (frame-ancestors 'none'), X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and Strict-Transport-Security.

hardening.justification: ruff's select = ["ALL"] includes the bandit S rules, so a hardening defect such as unsafe deserialization or shell injection fails the lint gate. CodeQL also runs on every pull request and every push to main. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml

implement_secure_design.justification: ASSURANCE_CASE.md's *Secure design principles* applies Saltzer and Schroeder's principles one by one -- economy of mechanism, fail-safe defaults, complete mediation, open design, least privilege, psychological acceptability -- each to the file or test that carries it. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/ASSURANCE_CASE.md

input_validation.justification: Every public function validates its inputs and refuses what is invalid with a BTClibMnemonicsTypeError or BTClibMnemonicsValueError, as CONTRIBUTING.md's *The public surface* requires; tests/input_validation_test.py drives the rule over every public function, and tests/fuzz_test.py holds every decoder to it on hostile sentences. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

installation_common.justification: `python -m pip install --upgrade btclib-mnemonics` installs it from PyPI, as README.md says, and pypi-install.yml installs the published version on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows after each release and weekly. https://pypi.org/project/btclib-mnemonics/

installation_development_quick.justification: `uv sync` installs the whole development environment in one command, uv being the only tool to install first; CONTRIBUTING.md's *The environment and the gates* section gives it beside `uv run pytest` and the lint gate. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

installation_standard_variables.justification: Installation is `pip install`, which follows pip's and the interpreter's own install-location conventions; there is no project-specific installer that could diverge from that convention. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/pyproject.toml

interfaces_current.justification: ruff's UP and FA rules flag deprecated constructs, and pytest turns every warning into an error. deps-latest and deps-oldest run the suite weekly at the newest and the floor versions. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/pyproject.toml

internationalization.justification: The text the package produces for end users is the mnemonic sentence itself, and it produces it in every language the specifications define word lists for: the twelve word lists of BIP39's reference implementation (Japanese joined by the ideographic space BIP39 requires) and Electrum's own; the language is read back off the words. SLIP-0039 defines English alone. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/tree/main/src/btclib_mnemonics/_data

know_common_errors.justification: ASSURANCE_CASE.md lists the common implementation weaknesses, such as CWE-209 and CWE-330, and what counters each: https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/ASSURANCE_CASE.md

know_secure_design.justification: The maintainer wrote ASSURANCE_CASE.md, which applies Saltzer and Schroeder's principles to the code one by one. It was reviewed by another owner in https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/issues/26.

license_location.justification: Non-trivial license location file in repository: <https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/LICENSE>.

license_per_file.justification: Every Python file states "Distributed under the MIT software license, see the accompanying LICENSE file or https://opensource.org/license/mit", e.g. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/src/btclib_mnemonics/__init__.py

maintained.justification: The repository is actively maintained: pull requests merge every week, and the latest release, v2026.10.8, is from 2026-10-08. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged

maintenance_or_update.justification: Only the latest release is supported and nothing is backported (SECURITY.md). RELEASING.md runs griffe check against the previous tag, and RELEASE_NOTES.md lists what a user must act on to upgrade. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/RELEASE_NOTES.md

no_leaked_credentials.justification: detect-secrets baseline gated by pre-commit, and GitHub secret scanning with push protection enabled on the repository: https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/.secrets.baseline

regression_tests_added50.justification: Every merged pull request that changes src/ also changes tests/, bar one that only edits a comment (#37). The 100% line and branch coverage gate also fails a fix whose new code no test runs. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged

release_notes.justification: RELEASE_NOTES.md holds each release's notes, and release.yml publishes the tag's section as the GitHub release body. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/releases/tag/v2026.10.8

release_notes_vulns.justification: The release notes name each advisory the release fixes: v2026.10.8 names GHSA-qjpp-8mp6-7744. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/releases/tag/v2026.10.8

repo_distributed.justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git is distributed.

repo_interim.justification: development is on the main branch of https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics

repo_public.justification: Repository on GitHub, which provides public git repositories with URLs.

repo_track.justification: Repository on GitHub, which uses git. git can track the changes, who made them, and when they were made.

report_process.justification: Bugs are reported on the GitHub issue tracker, through the issue forms under .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/, as CONTRIBUTING.md's *The issue tracker* describes: <https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/issues>. Vulnerabilities go through SECURITY.md instead: <https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/SECURITY.md>.

report_responses.justification: Every bug report so far was answered within two days and closed by a fix within three: issues #15 to #24, filed on 2026-09-30. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aclosed

report_tracker.justification: Each repository uses its own GitHub Issues tracker for individual issues, with issue forms under .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/, and an organization-wide tracker in btclib-org/.github for cross-repository findings. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/issues

require_2FA.justification: The btclib-org organization requires two-factor authentication of every member. https://github.com/btclib-org

roles_responsibilities.justification: GOVERNANCE.md's Roles names the maintainer, the owners, repository collaborators, contributors, reviewers, the review bot, Dependabot and pre-commit.ci, and what each owes. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md#roles

secure_2FA.justification: The btclib-org organization requires two-factor authentication and allows only secure methods: TOTP apps, security keys or passkeys, and GitHub Mobile, not SMS. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/issues/1362#issuecomment-5903994882

security_review.justification: pmazzocchi, an owner other than the maintainer, reviewed the project on 2026-09-30: https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/issues/26 . The review pins its scope to a commit, checks each claim of ASSURANCE_CASE.md, states what it did not cover and files each finding as an issue.

signed_releases.justification: Every PyPI file carries a PEP 740 attestation from Trusted Publishing, and each GitHub release a Sigstore provenance bundle. SECURITY.md gives the gh attestation verify command. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/releases/latest

sites_password_security.justification: Project sites are GitHub, PyPI and Read the Docs; this repository runs no site of its own that stores user passwords -- authentication is GitHub's and PyPI's, not this project's. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/SECURITY.md

small_tasks.justification: Small tasks for new contributors carry the label "good first issue", which CONTRIBUTING.md sets aside for a first contribution. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/issues?q=label%3A%22good+first+issue%22

static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities.justification: CodeQL's python analysis (codeql.yml) runs on a schedule, on every pull request and on every push to main, and ruff's `select = ["ALL"]` includes the bandit-derived S rules, both FLOSS static-analysis tools looking for common vulnerabilities. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml

static_analysis_often.justification: on every push and pull request: https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/actions/workflows/lint.yml, https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/actions/workflows/codeql.yml

test.justification: test.yml runs the suite, gated at 100% line and branch coverage, against vectors their authors publish: BIP39's reference implementation's and the Japanese ones BIP39 cites, SLIP-0039's and Electrum's. tests/_data/README.md pins each vendored file to its upstream commit. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/.github/workflows/test.yml

test_branch_coverage80.justification: pyproject.toml sets branch = true under [tool.coverage.run], and the 100% fail_under gate includes branches: https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/pyproject.toml

test_continuous_integration.justification: test.yml runs on every pull request and every push to main, and its aggregate job `test: every job passed` is a required check on main. Its runs on main are listed at https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/actions/workflows/test.yml

test_policy_mandated.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md requires 100% line and branch coverage, and fail_under = 100.0 fails the CI gate on any new code without a test. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

test_statement_coverage80.justification: pyproject.toml sets fail_under = 100.0, gated on every pull request by test.yml. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/pyproject.toml

test_statement_coverage90.justification: pyproject.toml sets fail_under = 100.0 under [tool.coverage.report], and the required test check enforces it on every pull request: https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/pyproject.toml

tests_documented_added.justification: CONTRIBUTING.md documents the 100% coverage gate, so new functionality is not accepted without a test. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

two_person_review.justification: main's ruleset requires one approving review, but the maintainer's pull_request-mode bypass remains, and recent pull requests landed without a non-author approval. https://github.com/btclib-org/.github/blob/main/README.md#review

updateable_reused_components.justification: At runtime the package reuses only the standard library. The test and tooling components are PyPI packages pinned in uv.lock and bumped by Dependabot, and the deps-latest sentinel runs the full suite against the upgraded set every week. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/.github/workflows/deps-latest.yml

version_semver.justification: CalVer, YYYY.M.D, declared in pyproject.toml and explained in RELEASE_NOTES.md: the number says when a release was cut and promises nothing about compatibility, so a breaking change is announced in RELEASE_NOTES.md. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/RELEASE_NOTES.md

version_tags.justification: Each release is tagged v<version> on the release commit, as RELEASING.md requires. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/tags

version_tags_signed.justification: Every release tag is signed, and RELEASING.md reads each signature back. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/tags

version_unique.justification: Each release carries a unique calendar version, YYYY.M.D, declared once in pyproject.toml and tagged v<version>. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/releases

vulnerabilities_critical_fixed.justification: No publicly known vulnerability is left unfixed: each published advisory names the release that fixes it. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/security/advisories

vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days.justification: No publicly known vulnerability is left unpatched. The findings of the 2026-09-30 security review were fixed within three days, and GHSA-qjpp-8mp6-7744 in v2026.10.8 the day it was found. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/security/advisories

vulnerability_report_credit.justification: The 2026-09-30 security review is credited to pmazzocchi in SECURITY.md and https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/issues/26 . GHSA-qjpp-8mp6-7744 had no outside reporter: the maintainer filed it from an audit of the organization's trees.

vulnerability_report_response.justification: Every vulnerability report so far was answered and fixed within three days of being filed: the security review's findings (https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/issues/26) and GHSA-qjpp-8mp6-7744. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/security/advisories

vulnerability_response_process.justification: SECURITY.md's Reporting a vulnerability gives the private channels (a GitHub security advisory, or security at btclib dot org), who can see a report, and how a CVE is requested. Private vulnerability reporting is enabled. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/SECURITY.md

warnings.justification: mypy strict with all relevant extra checks activated, see https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/pyproject.toml

warnings_fixed.justification: warning are not tolerated: mypy strict with all relevant extra checks activated, see https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/pyproject.toml

warnings_strict.justification: ruff runs with `select = ["ALL"]` (every rule family) and mypy runs with `strict = true`; both are zero-finding pre-commit hooks enforced again by the required lint workflow. https://github.com/btclib-org/btclib-mnemonics/blob/main/pyproject.toml
